rv.q: It's hard to imagine 'American Idiot' receiving a better, bolshier treatment, but only you and your misspent youth can decide if that's enough.
Being stoned does not make you the world’s most interesting dramatis personae.
There is at the heart of this musical a story worth caring about and Racky Plews stages it masterfully.
Sadly, American Idiot doesn’t manage this, and the results are bewildering.
These concerns are ultimately forgotten when the audience is thrown one head-banging hit after another, all concisely and neatly wrapped into an enjoyable show of 100 minutes.

cn.t: Green Day's punk musical earns mixed reviews, with critics praising its energetic staging and authentic grunge aesthetic but finding the thin narrative bewildering and hard to invest in emotionally.
